# 6. Confirmation That the Scrapers Are Custom-Built in Bright Data Scraper Studio

**Yes. The Scraper Studio collectors used in GapRadar were custom-built specifically for this project. We did not use or modify an existing scraper from Bright Data's Scrapers Library.**

GapRadar uses two custom Bright Data Scraper Studio collectors:

1. **`gapradar-fix-my-itch`** — used by Discovery Mode
2. **`gapradar-arxiv-research-v1`** — used by Investigation Mode

GapRadar also uses **Bright Data SERP API** for demand and competitor research. SERP API is a separate Bright Data product integration and is **not** presented as a Scraper Studio scraper.

---

## 1. `gapradar-fix-my-itch` — Custom Scraper Studio Collector

### Purpose

This collector was built specifically for GapRadar's **Discovery Mode** and targets Razorpay's public Fix My Itch page:

**https://razorpay.com/m/fix-my-itch/**

The scraper is designed around the structure of that page and GapRadar's own data requirements.

It extracts fields such as:

- Problem statement
- Description
- Industry
- Itch Score
- Severity score
- TAM score
- Whitespace score
- Frequency score
- Source information

### How we built it

This was **not**:

```text
Bright Data Scrapers Library
        ↓
Choose an existing Razorpay scraper
        ↓
Use it in GapRadar
```

It was:

```text
Bright Data Scraper Studio
        ↓
Create a new scraper for Fix My Itch
        ↓
Write our own interaction/navigation logic
        ↓
Write our own parser/extraction logic
        ↓
Define the structured output GapRadar expects
        ↓
Publish the collector
        ↓
Trigger it from the GapRadar backend
```

### Evidence — custom interaction/navigation code

The screenshot below shows the **Code** section of our `gapradar-fix-my-itch` scraper in Bright Data Scraper Studio. The selectors and interaction logic were written specifically for Razorpay Fix My Itch.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Custom Fix My Itch interaction code in Bright Data Scraper Studio" width="100%">

### Evidence — custom parser code

The parser is also custom-written for the Fix My Itch page and GapRadar's required output structure.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Custom Fix My Itch parser code in Bright Data Scraper Studio" width="100%">

### Evidence — real collector runs

The screenshot below shows real executions of `gapradar-fix-my-itch` inside Bright Data.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Fix My Itch Bright Data collector runs" width="100%">

At the time of the screenshot, the collector dashboard shows **8 completed runs and 931 records**, with successful production runs returning **133 records**.

### Discovery flow

```text
Razorpay Fix My Itch
        ↓
Custom Bright Data Scraper Studio collector
        ↓
Structured market-problem records
        ↓
GapRadar source validation
        ↓
RecallGuard reliability checks
        ↓
Opportunity Engine
        ↓
Discovery Mode
```

## 2. `gapradar-arxiv-research-v1` — Custom Scraper Studio Collector

### Purpose

This second Scraper Studio collector was built specifically for GapRadar's **Investigation Mode**.

When a user submits a hypothesis, GapRadar generates research queries and converts them into dynamic arXiv search URLs.

Our Bright Data collector receives those URLs and extracts academic research results from arXiv.

### Research flow

```text
User hypothesis
        ↓
GapRadar generates research queries
        ↓
GapRadar creates dynamic arXiv search URLs
        ↓
gapradar-arxiv-research-v1
        ↓
Bright Data visits the arXiv result page
        ↓
Custom parser extracts research results
        ↓
GapRadar receives academic evidence
        ↓
Research Evidence section
```

### Evidence — custom interaction/navigation code

The screenshot below shows the interaction code inside `gapradar-arxiv-research-v1`.

The collector reads the search URL supplied by GapRadar, handles the search parameters, and navigates to the requested arXiv search page.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Custom arXiv interaction code in Bright Data Scraper Studio" width="100%">

This means the collector is not restricted to one hard-coded topic. GapRadar can submit different arXiv search URLs depending on the user's Investigation.

### Evidence — custom parser code

The parser extracts paper URLs and result information from the arXiv results page.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Custom arXiv parser code in Bright Data Scraper Studio" width="100%">

### Evidence — production collector runs

The collector has been used repeatedly through API-triggered GapRadar runs.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="arXiv Bright Data collector runs" width="100%">

At the time of the screenshot, `gapradar-arxiv-research-v1` shows:

- **105 completed runs**
- **1,575 records**
- **118 inputs**
- **99.76% average success rate**

The run table also shows executions triggered **by API**, demonstrating that this collector is connected to GapRadar's backend workflow rather than existing only as a manual Scraper Studio demo.

## 3. Bright Data SERP API — Separate Bright Data Integration

GapRadar's third Bright Data usage is **not a Scraper Studio collector**.

For the wider-web portion of Investigation Mode, GapRadar uses the **Bright Data SERP API**.

It is used for:

- Demand evidence
- Competitor discovery
- Public-web validation of a hypothesis

### Investigation flow

```text
User hypothesis
        ↓
GapRadar generates web-search queries
        ↓
Bright Data SERP API
        ↓
Google organic search results
        ↓
GapRadar evidence normalization/classification
        ↓
Demand Evidence + Competitor Candidates
```

### Evidence — configured Bright Data SERP API

The screenshot below shows the active Bright Data Web Access / SERP API configuration used by GapRadar.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Bright Data SERP API configuration" width="100%">

This is a direct Bright Data API integration, not something we claim as a custom Scraper Studio scraper.

### Evidence — real SERP API usage

The Bright Data usage dashboard shows actual Google traffic generated through this integration.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Bright Data SERP API usage dashboard" width="100%">

At the time of the screenshot, the dashboard shows **49 requests** and approximately **5.98 MB** of data for `google.com`, providing evidence that GapRadar's Investigation web-search path is using the Bright Data SERP integration.

---

# What Is Custom-Built vs. What Is a Bright Data Product API?

| GapRadar capability | Bright Data product | Custom-built by us? | Role |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Fix My Itch problem collection | Scraper Studio | **Yes** | Discovery Mode |
| arXiv research collection | Scraper Studio | **Yes** | Investigation research |
| Google/public-web search | SERP API | API integration | Demand + competitor evidence |

The distinction is intentional:

- **Fix My Itch** and **arXiv** use our own Scraper Studio interaction and parser logic.
- **SERP API** is integrated through Bright Data's API and is not claimed as a custom scraper.

---

# Final Confirmation

> **Yes. GapRadar's `gapradar-fix-my-itch` and `gapradar-arxiv-research-v1` collectors were custom-built in Bright Data Scraper Studio specifically for this project. They were not pulled from Bright Data's existing Scrapers Library. We wrote the page-specific navigation/interaction logic, parsing logic, and structured output required by GapRadar ourselves.**
>
> **Separately, GapRadar uses Bright Data SERP API for demand evidence and competitor discovery in Investigation Mode. We explicitly identify this as a Bright Data API integration, not as a custom Scraper Studio scraper.**
